experiment: L10-PB17 Official SAM3 Direct Door-State Source Ceiling

post_run_integrity_adjudication.official_postprocessor_mechanism: Transformers 5.14.1 filters masks by score, resizes to target_sizes whenever the retained count is positive, and leaves the native spatial shape only when the retained count is zero.
post_run_integrity_adjudication.mechanical_implication: Because target_sizes was exactly [530,730] and the frozen assertion nevertheless observed a different spatial shape, the first positive frame retained zero instances for the exact text door at confidence 0.5.
post_run_integrity_adjudication.gate_implication: The preregistered gate required door-mask presence on all 4/4 positives. One mechanically established positive miss makes that conjunction false regardless of every unobserved row.

gate.reason: The exact door prompt retained zero instances on the first positive, so the required 4/4 positive conjunction is impossible.

route_disposition.next_admissible_action: Change the information source or representation and use a fresh cohort; do not repair the empty-mask shape assertion and rerun PB17.

claim_boundary: PB17 establishes only that the frozen original-SAM3 direct-door Development gate was not met because at least one fresh positive retained no door instance. It does not provide a complete confusion matrix or balanced accuracy, and it is not source-disjoint Confirmation, portal completeness, named-target ownership, access, traversability, active-view, guidance, arrival, product, user-benefit, or safety evidence.
